U.S. Bankruptcy Court // District of Delaware Case No. 18-11492 (OMG)

Third Amended Joint Plan of Reorganization

Debtor: Omni-Global Media, Inc.
Proponent: Aethelgard Holdings, LLC (dba Engine Room Records)

I. The "Toxic Asset" Designation

The Proponent asserts that the Debtor's primary assets (Legacy Master Recordings) are effectively "toxic" due to Gross Reputational Negligence following the "Visual Audit" scandal exposed by The Zenith Report.

The "Poison Pill" Logic: If the Lenders attempt to auction these assets to a third party (e.g., Private Equity), the O'Connell Family Trust will immediately file a $500 Million Class-Action Discrimination Suit. This litigation will freeze the assets for 5-10 years, rendering them unsellable.
II. The "White Knight" Settlement

Aethelgard Holdings offers to purchase 100% of the Senior Secured Debt at Par (100 cents on the dollar).

  • Condition 1: Immediate dismissal of the Board of Directors.
  • Condition 2: Repatriation of all "Legacy" copyrights to original artists at cost.
  • Condition 3: The "Liability Shield." Upon closing, the O'Connell family agrees to DROP all pending litigation, allowing the Lenders to exit without reputational damage.
Proof of Funds (Escrow)
$150,000,000.00
Verified: Wire Transfer Complete
Source: Aethelgard Holdings, LLC (Family Office)
STATUS: CONFIRMED.
The Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors has withdrawn its objection. The Plan is approved.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.
